omissions.a: A technical drawing of an ancient oil lamp (Fig. 68 a.) featuring a reservoir connected by tubes to the lamp body. The lamp has a flame at the wick and is supported by a decorative stand. Greek letters (δ, ε, ζ) label specific parts of the mechanism, including a small valve or key on the connecting pipe.
Ηρων ο Αλεξανδρεύς, Πνευματικά, λύχνος, ἔλαιον, σωλήν, κλειδία, μύξα
